title: PM condoles loss of lives in a mishap in Pauri Garhwal district, Uttarakhand
subtitle: PM announces ex-gratia from PMNRF
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep sorrow over the loss of lives in a mishap at Pauri Garhwal district, Uttarakhand. Shri Modi conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured. The Prime Minister announced an ex-gratia from PMNRF of Rs. 2 lakh to the next of kin of each deceased and Rs. 50,000 for those injured. The Prime Minister's Office posted on X; "Deeply disturbed to learn about the loss of lives in a mishap in Pauri Garhwal district of Uttarakhand. I extend my condolences to those who have lost their loved ones. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured. An ex-gratia of Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF would be given to the next of kin of each of those who lost their lives.
